method: The initial 30 accepted gloss outputs were compared with their submitted references on five contact sheets; three peer service outfits were compared on a sixth sheet and also viewed individually at native resolution. The four later gloss additions (Kouzou, OVA officer bob, Yuuji, Yuuki) were each inspected individually at native resolution with their identity reference. They were not viewed on the original sheets. The 33 previously reviewed asset hashes were verified unchanged; no re-review of edited assets is implied. All delivered native PNG bytes remain untouched.

summary.notes: No visible wrong-character substitution, clipped hair/feet, duplicate byte content or inappropriate presentation found in this reviewed set. All 34 gloss garments are ordinary athletic-swimwear adaptations. They are not reconstructions of the later requested Leona costume.

limitations: Exact 1:1 canonical appearance and pixel-perfect proportions are not certified. Sprite identities were compared with the supplied generated reference images, not original source artwork.
Rendering varies between fine pixel/anime shading and smoother cel-style highlights according to the provided reference; outlines and silhouette proportions are not mathematically identical.
Some native images contain faint color/alpha fringes at edges. No pixel cleanup or other raster manipulation was performed.

Three of the first 30 gloss outputs (OVA broadcasting-club member, OVA yellow-dress guest, Yuri) were recovered by inference after interruption. This limitation concerns provenance and is distinguished from their completed visual review. Kumi and Linda have exact direct-response/checkpoint associations; the four latest outputs are also directly recorded generation results.
